title: MCP protocol support matrix — @wasmagent/mcp-firewall / @wasmagent/mcp-server

status_definitions.verified: an automated test at tested_sha pins the behavior named in the row
status_definitions.partially-verified: some sub-behavior is test-pinned, a named conformance gap or untested sub-behavior remains
status_definitions.implemented-not-conformance-tested: code ships but no automated conformance test pins it
status_definitions.not-implemented: no implementation; a truthful terminal status, not a deficiency of this matrix
status_definitions.not-evaluated: existence/behavior plausible but never measured here
status_definitions.not-applicable: surface does not apply to this package boundary

protocol_revisions.name: MCP 2025-03-26 (Streamable HTTP introduced)
protocol_revisions.claim_ceiling: client-side transport support only; no server-side or wire conformance run against a 2025-03-26 suite
protocol_revisions.notes: No revision-specific gating exists in mcp-server; earlier revisions are served by the same handler without behavioral switch.

protocol_revisions.name: MCP 2025-06-18 (structured tool output)
protocol_revisions.claim_ceiling: structuredContent is parsed client-side; no dedicated conformance test for this revision

protocol_revisions.name: MCP 2025-11-25 stable (over-the-wire target)
protocol_revisions.claim_ceiling: verified for the methods/transports listed in this matrix; resources/* and prompts/* are NOT implemented; request cancellation (notifications/cancelled) is NOT implemented; zero-escape firewall claims are orthogonal and live in the F2 report
protocol_revisions.notes: PROTOCOL_VERSION = 2025-11-25 (McpAgentServer.ts). Declared capabilities: tools + tasks only.

protocol_revisions.name: MCP 2026-07-28 Release Candidate
protocol_revisions.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts:20-23 (design constraints); packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.ts:20-26 (older protocolVersion strings accepted during deprecation window)
protocol_revisions.claim_ceiling: DESIGNED WITHIN RC CONSTRAINTS (stateless core, no Mcp-Session-Id reliance, server never initiates requests, elicitation only inside an active request) — this is NOT 2026-07-28 conformance; no RC conformance suite has been run
protocol_revisions.notes: Deliberate wording boundary: 'compatible-by-design' must never be read as 'conformant'.

transport_framing.name: stdio transport (newline-delimited JSON-RPC)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: one message per line; stderr is log-only; framing per 2025-11-25 transports spec
transport_framing.notes: console.log is redirected to stderr to protect the wire format.

transport_framing.name: Streamable HTTP transport
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: POST JSON-RPC at a single configurable path with CORS + optional auth; no SSE response stream, no resumability replay

transport_framing.name: Legacy HTTP+SSE server transport
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: server-side SSE endpoint does not exist
transport_framing.notes: Client-side SSE fallback is a separate row (TF-SSE-CLIENT).

transport_framing.name: SSE fallback (client side)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: used only when Streamable HTTP is unavailable (SDK >= 1.7.0 required for Streamable)

transport_framing.name: Sessionless HTTP behavior (no Mcp-Session-Id reliance)
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/fetchHandler.ts (never reads Mcp-Session-Id); packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (fresh server instance reads task created by a prior instance)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: every request self-contained; long-task state keyed by task id in a swappable store

transport_framing.name: JSON-RPC batch (array body)
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (handles batch requests); packages/mcp-server/src/protocol-conformance.test.ts (PROTO-BATCH-01 batch-too-large 413, PROTO-DUPID-01 duplicate ids, PROTO-NOTIF-01/02 notification handling)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: maxBatchSize default 20 (413 beyond); stdio framing carries no batches (one message per line)
transport_framing.notes: GAP-BATCH-NOTIF resolved: notifications inside a batch get no response entry; all-notification batches return 204.

transport_framing.name: Malformed JSON
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/stdio.test.ts (-32700 with id null); packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (400 Invalid JSON over HTTP)

transport_framing.name: Malformed JSON-RPC envelope (wrong jsonrpc / missing method / non-object)
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (parse-error + invalid-request cases); packages/mcp-server/src/protocol-conformance.test.ts (PROTO-ENV-01 echoes request id on -32600)

transport_framing.name: Duplicate / null request-id edge cases
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/protocol-conformance.test.ts (PROTO-DUPID-01: duplicate ids in one batch each answered; PROTO-ENV-01: id echoed on envelope errors)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: the server answers each request independently; id correlation is the host's responsibility (documented)

transport_framing.name: Disconnect / reconnect
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/stdio.test.ts (stdin close exits); packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (stateless task store: fresh instance resumes a prior instance's task)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: resume is task-store-based (kill-and-resume), not transport-level replay; host re-initializes after reconnect

transport_framing.name: Sync-call timeout escalation
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (escalates to Tasks API when the sync timeout fires)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: default 25s sync timeout; escalation returns _meta.taskId, state persists

transport_framing.name: Task cancellation (tasks/cancel)
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (tasks/cancel marks an in-flight task as failed)

transport_framing.name: Request cancellation (notifications/cancelled)
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: notifications are never dispatched to handlers (packages/mcp-server/src/stdio.ts; packages/mcp-server/src/stdio.test.ts notification case)
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: in-flight request cancellation is NOT supported; use tasks/cancel for long-running work

transport_framing.name: Concurrent requests on one server instance
transport_framing.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/protocol-conformance.test.ts (PROTO-CONC-01); packages/mcp-server/src/stdio.ts handles lines without awaiting the previous one
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: per-request isolation; ordering across requests is not guaranteed (host correlates by id)

transport_framing.name: Backpressure / flow control
transport_framing.claim_ceiling: only bounds that exist: 1 MiB request-body cap, 20-item batch cap, 200-event task log cap
transport_framing.notes: No measurement of behavior under sustained overload exists.

methods.name: initialize
methods.claim_ceiling: capability flags are objects per spec convention (Zod-validated by major hosts)

methods.name: Protocol-version negotiation (echo/agree with client preference)
methods.claim_ceiling: server always declares its own stable version; older strings are tolerated by design (deprecation windows), never echoed
methods.notes: Documented stance, tested as documentation — not spec-mandated negotiation.

methods.name: tools/call
methods.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (final_answer content blocks; -32602 missing name; -32011 unknown tool)
methods.notes: Firewall-side call gating is the MCPGateway surface, see firewall_inspection section.

methods.name: resources/* (resources/list, resources/read, …)
methods.test_or_evidence: absence in McpAgentServer.handle dispatch; initialize capabilities declare tools+tasks only
methods.notes: Truthful not-implemented; not scheduled by this matrix.

methods.name: Notifications (no-id messages)
methods.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/stdio.test.ts (notification gets NO response); packages/mcp-server/src/protocol-conformance.test.ts (PROTO-NOTIF-01..03 over HTTP/batch)
methods.claim_ceiling: notifications are handled for side effects only, never answered (stdio, single HTTP 202, batch entries dropped); server emits no notifications (listChanged false, no progress)

methods.name: Tasks API (tasks/create, tasks/get, tasks/cancel, tasks/respond, tasks/list)
methods.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-server/src/McpAgentServer.test.ts (create/get/cancel/respond/list; -32010 unknown id; -32012 not-awaiting; stateless store resume)
methods.claim_ceiling: InMemoryTaskStore default; KV-swappable via McpTaskStore; sync-timeout escalation shares the same store

methods.name: Elicitation (await_human_input via tasks/respond)
methods.claim_ceiling: elicitation happens only inside an active task (2026-07-28-RC-compatible design constraint)

methods.name: sampling/createMessage (server-initiated)
methods.test_or_evidence: absence in mcp-server; sampling callback exists client-side
methods.claim_ceiling: server never initiates requests (sessionless design constraint)

methods.name: Extension methods / unknown method handling
methods.claim_ceiling: no extension surface; typed MCP error codes (-32010/-32011/-32012) honored from thrown errors

firewall_inspection.name: Registration / descriptor inspection (vetting at list time)
firewall_inspection.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-firewall/src/firewall.test.ts (vetTool); packages/mcp-firewall/src/gateway.test.ts (server card + evaluate); evals F0/F1 corpus gates
firewall_inspection.claim_ceiling: semantic detection is defence-in-depth, not the root of trust

firewall_inspection.name: Call-argument policy (structural value signals, tenant, sinks)
firewall_inspection.claim_ceiling: name heuristics are supplementary; profiles/structural signals are authoritative

firewall_inspection.name: Server → client result handling (taint observation, quarantine rendering)
firewall_inspection.claim_ceiling: rendering-level boundary for prompt assembly; NOT a response-content DLP product

firewall_inspection.name: Taint label propagation across derived observations
firewall_inspection.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-firewall/src/taint-labels.test.ts (propagateTaint); packages/mcp-firewall/src/provenance-gate.test.ts (labels enter sink decisions via GatewayRequest.inputProvenance); packages/core/src/agents/ToolCallingAgent.provenance.test.ts (per-run port threading); packages/mcp-gateway/src/agent-loop.test.ts (adapter mints profile-declared result labels)
firewall_inspection.claim_ceiling: explicit propagation via API calls; propagated labels are decision-load-bearing (IF-07a gate); threading is caller-side or run-scoped by a wired agent runtime (IF-07c); no automatic process-wide taint ledger

firewall_inspection.name: Result-to-next-call information flow (post-call reuse as arguments)
firewall_inspection.test_or_evidence: packages/mcp-firewall/src/provenance-gate.test.ts (GATE-01..11); packages/mcp-firewall/src/information-flow.test.ts (IF-07a denied via provenance threading, IF-07a-2 identity match at renamed/nested args); packages/mcp-gateway/src/agent-loop.test.ts (end-to-end: labeled read → automatic deny at the next sink)
firewall_inspection.claim_ceiling: threaded-provenance reuse of sensitive data at dangerous sinks is denied by labels + content identity, not value shape; within a wired ToolCallingAgent run the runtime threads the run-scoped ledger automatically (IF-07c, opt-in); flows outside a wired run remain caller responsibility (no automatic process-wide taint ledger); semantic result-text detection is not the root of trust
firewall_inspection.notes: IF-07a flipped from documented limitation to enforced deny by the provenance gate; IF-07c made the threading automatic within wired agent runs (run-scoped).

firewall_inspection.name: Response secret/PII enforcement (DLP over returned content)
firewall_inspection.test_or_evidence: taint tagging marks observations; no content-scanning DLP over tool results
firewall_inspection.claim_ceiling: taint tagging must NOT be presented as response DLP

firewall_inspection.name: Cross-tool information-flow enforcement
firewall_inspection.test_or_evidence: sink-policy rules (SECRET_NETWORK_SINK_RULE, capability registry) constrain cross-boundary effects per call; packages/mcp-firewall/src/provenance-policy.ts enforces threaded cross-tool flows at the next sink decision; fixtures IF-07a/IF-07a-2; packages/core/src/agents/ToolCallingAgent.provenance.test.ts; packages/mcp-gateway/src/agent-loop.test.ts
firewall_inspection.claim_ceiling: enforced for threaded provenance (labels + content identity) — caller-threaded or run-scoped by a wired agent runtime (IF-07c); no cross-run or process-wide taint ledger exists — flows outside a wired run remain caller responsibility
firewall_inspection.notes: Information-flow fixture family documents exactly where boundaries hold. IF-07c wires the threading into the agent loop (run-scoped, opt-in).

conformance_gaps.description: RESOLVED: a notification inside a JSON-RPC batch used to produce an id:null error entry in the batch reply, and a lone notification over HTTP used to return 200 with an error body instead of 202/no-body. Fixed in the conformance patch; PROTO-NOTIF-01..03 pin the corrected behavior.
conformance_gaps.disposition: resolved — rows flipped to verified with pinned tests

claim_ceiling_global: This matrix is a project-owned conformance inventory at one tested commit, not an independent certification.
not-implemented rows are truthful terminal states; nothing here asserts scheduled delivery.
2026-07-28-RC compatibility is a design-constraint statement only.
Firewall rows describe per-call enforcement boundaries; none extends the kernel/sandbox/network-enforcement claim of the runtime.
